name: Brown's Berry Patch
tagline: These Old Games: Brown's Berry Patch
description: Brown's Berry Patch is an agritourism farm in 14264 Roosevelt Highway, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
